name: Tropical Assemblies Inc

about:
Tropical Assemblies Inc operates from a facility at 4066 NE 5th Avenue in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. The company’s founding year and ownership structure have not been disclosed publicly.

The company provides electronic manufacturing services (EMS) with a focus on high-complexity, high-reliability assemblies. Its capabilities span printed circuit board assembly, electro-mechanical integration, RF and high-frequency communications hardware, LED lighting electronics, and full box-build services. Tropical Assemblies also offers design support covering hardware, firmware, and mechanical engineering, along with supply chain management. The firm describes its operation as a "Smart Technology Factory" with real-time data tracking and audited quality systems.

Tropical Assemblies serves the aerospace, defense, medical, communications, LED lighting, and industrial controls sectors. In aerospace, it produces electronics for commercial and military programs worldwide. For defense, it supplies circuit board and electro-mechanical assemblies to armed forces. Its medical work, compliant with ISO 13485, supports device pioneers globally. The communications practice specializes in RF/HF systems, while the industrial controls group brings combined hardware, software, and mechanical design to market.

The company highlights its recognition as a finalist for the South Florida Manufacturers Association’s 2020 Manufacturer of the Year award and emphasizes its certified quality standards—AS9100, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, ITAR registration, and UL certification—as core differentiators.
